why: I compared every file, script and command the issue names against the repository. It fails in two places. First, the problem says "average() in src/stats.js returns NaN", but there is no src/stats.js. `average` is defined in math.js at the repo root, and the issue doesn't ask anyone to create src/stats.js, so the problem misdescribes the repo. Second, the expect line and proof "`npm run lint` exits 0" call a script that doesn't exist: package.json has only a "test" script (`node --test`), so `npm run lint` would fail with a missing-script error. The rest checks out: math.js and test/math.test.js exist, and `npm test`, `node --test` and the exports add, subtract, multiply and average are all real.
